get.description:
Retrieve the full pre-computed Attribution insights payload for a campaign.

Returns a single document containing `events`, `totals`, `chart`,
`performance_summary`, `sec_summary`, and `audience_summary`. Top-N
ranking, scope filtering, and conversion-rate rollups are all performed
on the frontend per PRO-138 / DATA-874.

Returns 404 if the campaign does not exist, no insights document exists,
or the stored insights document is not of type Attribution.

200.description: Get full Attribution insights document for a campaign

post.description:
Dismiss a suggested audience for a smart campaign.

- Moves suggestion to DISMISSED status
- Creates record in campaign_history collection
- Removes from suggestions array in campaign

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    suggestionId: Audience code of the suggestion
    dismissal_data: Optional reason for dismissal

Returns:
    Updated campaign without the dismissed suggestion

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign
    404: Campaign or suggestion not found

Accept a suggested audience and add it to the campaign audiences.

- Moves suggestion to ACCEPTED status
- Adds audience to audiences array
- Removes from suggestions array
- Re-estimates reach, duration, and updates nested_traits from all audiences

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    suggestionId: Audience code of the suggestion

Returns:
    Updated campaign with new audience added

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign
    404: Campaign or suggestion not found
    409: Audience code already exists in campaign

200.description: Accept and add suggested audience to campaign

get.description:
Retrieve change history for a specific campaign.

Useful for:
- Data team to review what was dismissed (filter by suggestion_dismissed)
- Users to see full audit trail
- Analytics on suggestion quality
- Compliance and reporting

Query Parameters:
- change_type: Filter by specific type (suggestion_dismissed, suggestion_accepted,
               performance_updated, audience_added, audience_removed, etc.)
- page: Page number (1-indexed)
- size: Items per page (max 100)

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    change_type: Optional filter for change type
    page: Page number
    size: Items per page

Returns:
    Paginated list of campaign history records

200.description: Get change history for a campaign

get.description:
Get all suggestions for a smart campaign.

Returns the list of pending, accepted, and dismissed suggestions.
For full campaign details including audiences, use GET /campaigns/{campaignId}

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID

Returns:
    List of suggestions with their status

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign
    404: Campaign not found

200.description: Get suggestions for a smart campaign

post.description:
Add new suggestions to a smart campaign (typically used by data team).

The system automatically:
- Checks dismissal history to prevent re-suggesting dismissed audiences
- Filters out suggestions with audience codes that already exist
- Creates history records for each added suggestion

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    suggestions_data: Array of suggestions to add (max 20)

Returns:
    Summary with added and skipped suggestions

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign or invalid data
    404: Campaign not found

200.description: Add suggestions to a smart campaign

patch.description:
Update performance metrics for existing audiences in a smart campaign.

Typically used by the data team to update performance ratings based on analytics.
Creates history records for each performance update.

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    performance_data: Array of performance updates

Returns:
    Updated campaign with new performance ratings

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign or invalid performance rating
    404: Campaign or audience not found

post.description:
Bulk add audiences to a smart campaign.

- Adds each audience to the smart campaign audiences array
- Skips audience codes that already exist in the campaign
- Creates campaign_history records (change_type="audience_added") for each
- Re-estimates reach, duration, and nested_traits from all audiences

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    audiences_data: Array of audiences to add (max 50)

Returns:
    Summary with added/skipped audiences and updated campaign

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign
    404: Campaign not found

200.description: Bulk add audiences to a smart campaign

delete.description:
Remove an audience from a smart campaign.

- Removes audience from audiences array
- Re-estimates reach, duration, and updates nested_traits from remaining audiences
- Creates record in campaign_history collection (change_type="audience_removed")

Args:
    campaignId: Campaign ID
    audienceCode: Audience code to remove
    removal_data: Optional reason for removal

Returns:
    Updated campaign without the removed audience

Raises:
    400: Not a Smart campaign
    404: Campaign or audience not found

200.description: Remove an audience from a smart campaign

get.description:
Seed Smart Campaigns with performance data and AI-generated suggestions.

This endpoint populates Smart Campaigns with:
- Performance ratings (Excellent/Good/Average/Poor) for existing audiences
- AI-generated audience suggestions with realistic data
- Proper audit trail in campaign_history collection

Query Parameters:
- campaign_id: Seed a specific campaign (optional, if not provided seeds all)
- parent_id: Filter campaigns by company/sub-company (optional)
- num_suggestions: Number of suggestions to add per campaign (1-20, default: 5)
- add_performance: Whether to add performance data to audiences (default: true)
- add_suggestions: Whether to add AI suggestions (default: true)

Examples:
- Seed all smart campaigns: GET /seed/smart-campaigns
- Seed specific campaign: GET /seed/smart-campaigns?campaign_id=6957d233ed139f90b161370c
- Seed for a company: GET /seed/smart-campaigns?parent_id=Octave
- Add 10 suggestions: GET /seed/smart-campaigns?num_suggestions=10
- Only add suggestions: GET /seed/smart-campaigns?add_performance=false
- Only add performance: GET /seed/smart-campaigns?add_suggestions=false

Returns:
    Summary of seeding operation including campaigns processed and changes made

Seed the campaign_insights collection with realistic sample data.

Generates 90 days of time series, 7 targeting change batches with
20 total audience operations, and derived summary statistics.

If a campaign already has insights data it will be replaced.

Query Parameters:
- campaign_id: Seed insights for a specific campaign (optional)
- parent_id: Seed insights for all campaigns under a company (optional)

Examples:
- Seed all campaigns: GET /seed/campaign-insights
- Seed specific campaign: GET /seed/campaign-insights?campaign_id=6957d233ed139f90b161370c
- Seed for a company: GET /seed/campaign-insights?parent_id=Octave

delete.description:
Delete a user from Cognito, the database, and QuickSight.

Process:
1. Retrieve user record from DB (to obtain email and company for QS cleanup)
2. Attempt to delete from Cognito
3. If user deleted from Cognito OR user doesn't exist in Cognito:
   - Proceed to delete from database
4. Best-effort removal from QuickSight (revoke dashboard + delete QS user)
5. If Cognito deletion fails with an error:
   - Do NOT delete from database to maintain data consistency
   - Raise HTTP 500 error

Args:
    user_cognito_id: The Cognito user ID to delete

Returns:
    Success response with deletion details

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Cognito deletion fails due to error or user not found anywhere
